items.source_en:
Despite the proprietary work currently being done, Taris Shipyard continues to maintain its stock of starships. As always, we offer several different classes for several different customer types and budgets. 

But, after meeting with Clarence and Aisiha, I agree with their findings. We need to expect - and plan for - either a.) a decrease in standard ship production OR b.) retrofitting existing ship classes with the Graviton Loop Array.

The following is Aisha's proposal for updated ship classes, and their roles - each fitted with a Graviton Loop Array (i.e.Hyperdrive):

- Discovery - Exploration
- Endeavor - Deep-Range Exploration
- Econohaul - Cargo
- Ranger - Medium-Range Multi-Role
- Mayflower - Long-Range Colony
- Blackhawk - Medium-Range Multi-Role
- Mustang - Short-Range System Defense
- Spitfire - Short-Range Heavy System Defense
- Kfir - Long-Range Fighter
- Spirit - Long-Range Destroyer
- Constitution - Medium-Range Cruiser
- Zumwalt - Long-Range Destroyer
- Bismark - Medium-Range Battleship
- Yamato - Long-Range Battleship
- Kirov - Medium-Range Cruiser
- Nimitz - Medium-Range Heavy Cruiser

items.source_en:
Welcome to Dantooine.
Compromise puts everyone at risk. Follow protocol at all times.

• Do not transmit sensitive data over unsecured channels
• Avoid real names, locations, or identifiable details
• Use approved encryption methods only
• Rotate access codes and ciphers regularly
• Limit communication to mission-essential information
• Verify all contacts before sharing intel
• Assume all channels are monitored
• Report unusual signal interference or tracking attempts immediately
• Do not access this terminal twice from the same route
• Wipe local logs after use

Your caution protects more than just yourself. The Resistance is grateful for your perseverance.

Another day, another giant rock. The rock currently in question is Kessel, which is... eh. It's a moon. It's in space. It's got ore. Like the last hundred.
